title: GNW predicts conscious content is decodable from prefrontal cortex

statements.text: Conscious content, including its category and its features, is decodable from prefrontal cortex, independent of whether the stimulus is task-relevant.
statements.conditions: Preregistered by the Cogitate adversarial collaboration with Stanislas Dehaene as the GNW proponent. The OSF project osf.io/mbcfy was created 2019-01-16, and the protocol states the preregistration and its amendments were frozen before data acquisition. The exact freeze date is not stated in the open protocol.

prediction.resolution_criterion: The Cogitate experiment 1 finds category and orientation of task-irrelevant stimuli decodable from prefrontal regions of interest.

sources.quote: GNW predicts that conscious content will be decodable from areas in the prefrontal cortex
